zh: 瓷砖最多三块，可以把“已经用了几块”放进状态：对每个前缀，记录用至多 t 块（t 为 0 到 3）能覆盖的最大和。
看前缀的最后一个元素：要么不被覆盖，结果和前一个前缀相同；要么被一块瓷砖覆盖，这块必然盖住最后两个元素，前面接上“少一块、少两个元素”的最优方案。
滚动保存前两个前缀的四个状态，初值都为 0（表示可以一块不放）。处理第 i 个元素时，新状态先复制上一个前缀的状态；若 i≥1，对 t 为 1 到 3，取“上一个前缀的 t 状态”与“再往前一个前缀的 t−1 状态加上 a[i−1]+a[i]”中的较大者。最后输出至多 3 块的状态。和可能超过 32 位。
en: There are at most three tiles, so put the number used into the state: for each prefix, record the best covered sum using at most t tiles, for t from 0 to 3.

Look at the last element of the prefix: either it is uncovered and the result equals that of the previous prefix, or a tile covers it, in which case the tile covers the last two elements and follows the best solution with one fewer tile on the prefix two elements shorter.

Keep the four states of the two previous prefixes, all starting at 0 (placing no tile is allowed). For element i, start the new states as a copy of the previous prefix; if i≥1, for t from 1 to 3 take the larger of the previous prefix's state t and the state t−1 of the prefix before it plus a[i−1]+a[i]. Print the state for at most 3 tiles. Sums can exceed 32 bits.

explanationEn:
## Approach

A prefix DP maintains the maximum sum using at most 0, 1, 2, 3 tiles. The last element may stay uncovered; or one tile covers the last two cells and follows the best solution, with one fewer tile, that ends before those two cells.

## Correctness

If a valid solution covers the last cell, its last tile must cover the last two cells and nothing before may overlap it; otherwise the solution belongs to a shorter prefix. The two branches exhaust all solutions, and initializing with zero allows not using tiles with negative gain.

## Complexity

Time O(3N), space O(1) apart from the input.
